title: The Chessboard
summary: Learn your way around the board before meeting the pieces.

steps.text: Welcome! Chess is played on a board with 64 squares. Let's learn our way around before we meet the pieces!
The 8 up-and-down columns are called FILES. They're labeled a to h, left to right from White's side.
The 8 side-to-side rows are called RANKS. They're numbered 1 to 8, starting closest to White.
Every square has its own name: its file letter plus its rank number. The circled square is called e4.
White's pieces start on ranks 1 and 2. Black's pieces start on ranks 7 and 8. Ready to meet the pieces?
